prompt: Objective: increase a city's recycling rate. What you've learned: the city recycles 30% of waste. Latest finding: one neighborhood recycles only 10%. What is the best next step?

options.text: Compare the city's rate with other cities
options.feedback: Less useful: one neighborhood stands out.

options.text: Estimate what fines for not recycling would raise
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix before knowing the cause.

options.text: Find out why that one neighborhood recycles so little
options.feedback: Right. One neighborhood stands out, so understand why.

options.text: Measure recycling rates month by month
options.feedback: The finding is about place, not time.

explanation: One neighborhood recycles 10% against 30% citywide. Find out why.
